transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
GSK and Cognizant use artificial intelligence agents to streamline drug safety workflows and cut processing time by 40 to 50 percent, according to Newsweek Confirmed.
The National Rail Administration installs artificial intelligence cameras at 8 Jaipur stations to prevent trespassing and boost safety, reported by The Times of India.
Nvidia loses its China artificial intelligence accelerator market as enterprises deploy liquid cooled artificial intelligence factories with GPU backed financing, per Yahoo Finance Reported.
OpenAI and NASK partner on artificial intelligence safety, giving Polish researchers access to frontier models, according to TechGig Reported.
Outside Idaho Capitol, PauseAI protesters call for artificial intelligence regulations, reported by Boise State University The Arbiter Online.
Free every hour.
